csv_project_name: AE Services for Parish Department Engineering & Public Works
csv_scope_of_work: The Parish of Plaquemines is hereby soliciting submittals of Statements of Qualifications from firms interested in providing Professional Engineering, Architectural and Construction Administration Services to the Department of Engineering and Public Works on an as needed basis. The Parish wishes to contract with a firm to supplement the Engineering Department in assisting with engineering/architectural technical support, construction field inspection, project management and any other engineering/architectural related services required on a project specific basis.

relevance_explanation:
